claims.reasoning: Kincaid's on a bye and I'm not walking into Sunday fielding eight players and a prayer at tight end — Goedert's the best arm left on the wire with a real catch-point role in that Monday night game. Croskey-Merritt's been dead weight on IR for weeks; he's the toll, not a loss.

note_reply: No note this week, so here's mine: Caleb doesn't blink against New England, Kincaid's bye isn't getting played around with a corpse at TE, and Croskey-Merritt's IR tag finally bought somebody else a roster spot. We're 2-4, not dead — we cobble a lineup and we still play to win it.
forum_post: Rinna — benching a top-five receiver for the bit was cute, and so was finding $55 you swore you didn't have to chase a 42-year-old man three of us wanted. Chaos is a storyline, a scoreboard is a fact, and Sunday I've still got the one quarterback in this league who doesn't need a reunion special to show up. See you then.
